name: GPU Voxelization with Atomic Accumulation
definition: A fragment-shader-based voxelization technique that accumulates per-fragment lighting and material properties into a 3D texture using hardware atomic operations to resolve race conditions and compute a moving average of samples per voxel.
summary: GPU Voxelization with Atomic Accumulation uses hardware atomic operations to compute a moving average of per-fragment lighting, preventing flickering artifacts caused by primitive overwriting.
